activity_statements.statement: operates 50+ hospital campuses and hundreds of outpatient care sites across nine states, delivering inpatient and outpatient clinical care
employs 100,000+ caregivers across physician practices, hospitals, outpatient clinics, skilled nursing facilities, home health agencies, and hospice centers
coordinates value-based care and population health management through the AdventHealth Population Health Services Organization (PHSO) and AdventHealth Provider Network (AHPN)
provides whole-person care integrating physical, emotional, and spiritual wellness under a Christian mission of 'Extending the Healing Ministry of Christ'
offers skilled nursing, home health, and hospice services as part of a post-acute care continuum

name_reality_gap: AdventHealth's name does not readily signal the organization's scale (50+ hospitals, nine states, 100,000+ caregivers) or its Seventh-day Adventist religious mission. The 'Hospitals & Health Care' label is accurate at a category level but understates that it is a fully integrated system spanning acute, post-acute, and population health.
extraction_notes: Multiple AdventHealth URLs (hospitals-and-locations, about-adventhealth, careers What-We-Do) returned 404 or 500 errors. Who-we-are page provided sufficient detail for a solid profile. Financial data unavailable (private nonprofit).
